universal.zh: 撐住變速箱尾端的橫樑，中間一塊橡膠腳吸收震動。拆它之前要先用頂車架撐住變速箱。
universal.en: The crossmember carrying the back of the gearbox on a rubber mount. Support the gearbox on a jack before unbolting it.

specific.zh: 模擬器把它列為拆變速箱的前提。
specific.en: The simulator lists it as a prerequisite for gearbox removal.

universal.zh: 輪圈加輪胎，用五顆螺絲鎖在輪轂上。幾乎所有底盤工作的第一步。
universal.en: Rim and tyre, held to the hub by five bolts. The first step of nearly every chassis job.

specific.zh: BMW 用輪圈螺絲（不是螺帽），扭力約 120–140 Nm（待查證）。車頂起前先鬆螺絲一圈。
specific.en: BMW uses wheel bolts rather than nuts, torqued to roughly 120–140 Nm (unverified). Crack them loose before lifting the car.

warnings.zh: 頂車後一定架頂車架。
warnings.en: Always put the car on stands after jacking.

universal.zh: 鎖在車身底下的鋼架，懸吊臂、轉向機和引擎腳都鎖在它上面。車身本身不直接承受這些力。
universal.en: A steel frame bolted under the body; the suspension arms, steering rack and engine mounts all bolt to it, so the body itself does not take those loads directly.

specific.zh: 引擎腳在副車架上，所以要放下副車架前，得用支撐橫樑把引擎吊住。
specific.en: Because the engine mounts sit on it, the engine must hang from a support bar before the subframe is lowered.

warnings.zh: 副車架螺絲一次性（待查證），而且要照角度鎖。
warnings.en: Subframe bolts are single-use (unverified) and torqued with an angle.

universal.zh: 引擎和車架之間的橡膠（或液壓）塊，把引擎抖動隔開。
universal.en: The rubber or hydraulic block between engine and frame that isolates vibration.

specific.zh: N20 用液壓引擎腳（待查證）。換時用支撐橫樑把引擎吊起一點。
specific.en: The N20 uses hydraulic mounts (unverified). Lift the engine slightly on a support bar to swap one.

warnings.zh: 拆引擎腳前引擎一定要吊住。
warnings.en: The engine must be supported before a mount comes off.

commonIssues.zh: 液壓腳漏油塌陷：怠速抖、換檔頓。
commonIssues.en: A leaking mount collapses: idle shake and clunks on shifts.

universal.zh: 引擎和車架之間的橡膠（或液壓）塊，把引擎抖動隔開。
universal.en: The rubber or hydraulic block between engine and frame that isolates vibration.

specific.zh: N20 用液壓引擎腳（待查證）。換時用支撐橫樑把引擎吊起一點。
specific.en: The N20 uses hydraulic mounts (unverified). Lift the engine slightly on a support bar to swap one.

warnings.zh: 拆引擎腳前引擎一定要吊住。
warnings.en: The engine must be supported before a mount comes off.

commonIssues.zh: 液壓腳漏油塌陷：怠速抖、換檔頓。
commonIssues.en: A leaking mount collapses: idle shake and clunks on shifts.

universal.zh: 一根 U 形彈簧鋼，兩端用連桿接左右支柱，中間用襯套固定在副車架。過彎時外側壓縮會把內側一起拉下去，減少側傾。
universal.en: A U-shaped spring bar linked to both struts, held to the subframe by bushes. In a corner the outer side compresses and drags the inner side with it, reducing roll.

specific.zh: 連桿（end link）的球頭常壞，過坎有喀喀聲。
specific.en: The end-link ball joints wear and knock over bumps.

universal.zh: 麥花臣式：避震器和彈簧做成一支，下端夾在轉向節，上端鎖在車身塔頂。它同時是懸吊又是轉向軸。
universal.en: MacPherson type: damper and spring in one unit, clamped to the knuckle at the bottom and bolted to the body turret at the top. It is both suspension and the steering pivot.

specific.zh: F30 前支柱用一顆夾緊螺絲固定在轉向節上，上座三顆螺帽。拆彈簧要用彈簧壓縮器。
specific.en: The F30 strut is held in the knuckle by one pinch bolt, with three nuts at the top mount. Spring removal needs a compressor.

fasteners.desc: 塔頂螺帽 / Top mount nuts

warnings.zh: 彈簧壓縮器用錯會致命；壓力沒釋放前不要鬆中心螺帽。
warnings.en: A spring compressor used wrongly can kill; never loosen the centre nut until the spring is captured.

consequence.zh: 沒壓住彈簧就鬆支柱中心螺帽：彈簧會爆開，力量足以致命。
consequence.en: Undoing the strut centre nut with the spring uncompressed: the spring releases with enough force to kill.

commonIssues.zh: 避震漏油、塔頂軸承轉方向有異音。
commonIssues.en: Damper leaks; a noisy top bearing when turning.

name.zh: 左前轉向節（含輪轂軸承）

universal.zh: 輪子真正鎖上去的那塊：裡面是輪轂軸承，外面接支柱、兩根下臂球頭和轉向拉桿。
universal.en: The piece the wheel actually bolts to: the hub bearing inside, with the strut, two lower-arm ball joints and the tie rod attached outside.

specific.zh: F30 的轉向節是鋁合金（待查證）。輪轂軸承是整組式，壞了連輪轂一起換。
specific.en: The F30 knuckle is aluminium (unverified). The hub bearing is a cartridge unit, replaced with the hub.

commonIssues.zh: 軸承嗡嗡聲隨車速變、轉向時變大聲。
commonIssues.en: A bearing hum that rises with speed and changes when turning.

universal.zh: 雙關節前懸吊把傳統的三角形 A 臂拆成兩根：這根是後面彎的那根（控制臂），和前面直的拉桿一起定住輪子的下端。
universal.en: The double-joint front suspension splits the classic wishbone into two arms: this is the rear, curved one (control arm), which with the front tension strut locates the bottom of the wheel.

specific.zh: F30 這根通常是鋁合金鍛造，內側襯套、外側球頭都不能單換，整支換。
specific.en: On the F30 this is usually forged aluminium; neither the inner bush nor the ball joint is sold separately, so the arm is replaced whole.

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在車輪承重（正常高度）時鎖緊，否則襯套很快撕裂。
warnings.en: Torque the bush bolt with the suspension at ride height, or the bush tears early.

commonIssues.zh: 球頭鬆：煞車時方向盤抖、過坎喀喀。
commonIssues.en: A loose joint shakes the wheel under braking and knocks over bumps.

universal.zh: 雙關節前懸吊的第二根下臂，往前斜，主要承受煞車與加速的前後力。
universal.en: The second lower arm of the double-joint layout, angled forward; it takes most of the fore-and-aft braking and acceleration loads.

specific.zh: 內側是大顆液壓襯套（待查證），老化後煞車時方向盤會抖。
specific.en: The inner end is a large hydraulic bush (unverified); when it ages the wheel shakes under braking.

commonIssues.zh: 液壓襯套漏油：煞車抖、路感鬆散。
commonIssues.en: Leaking hydro bush: braking shimmy and a vague feel.

universal.zh: 麥花臣式：避震器和彈簧做成一支，下端夾在轉向節，上端鎖在車身塔頂。它同時是懸吊又是轉向軸。

commonIssues.zh: 液壓襯套漏油：煞車抖、路感鬆散。
commonIssues.en: Leaking hydro bush: braking shimmy and a vague feel.

universal.zh: 和前面一樣的 U 形桿，接在後副車架與後下臂之間。
universal.en: The same U-shaped bar as at the front, between the rear subframe and the lower arms.

universal.zh: 後懸吊的彈簧和避震器是分開的：避震器只負責吸收彈簧的來回震盪，不撐車重。
universal.en: At the rear the spring and damper are separate: the damper only kills the spring's bounce and carries no weight.

specific.zh: 下端一顆螺絲鎖在後羽臂，上端在行李廂側邊的輪拱內（要拆內飾板）。
specific.en: One bolt at the bottom into the wheel carrier; the top is inside the boot side trim.

commonIssues.zh: 漏油、回彈變差，車尾浮。
commonIssues.en: Leaks and lost rebound control; the tail floats.

universal.zh: 撐車重的螺旋彈簧，夾在下臂和車身之間。避震器拆掉後，下臂往下放就能把彈簧取出。
universal.en: The coil that carries the car's weight, trapped between the lower arm and the body. With the damper off, let the arm swing down and the spring comes out.

specific.zh: F30 後彈簧有顏色標記分級（待查證），兩邊要同一級。
specific.en: F30 rear springs carry colour codes for rate classes (unverified); both sides must match.

warnings.zh: 下臂放下時彈簧還有壓力，人不要在正下方。
warnings.en: The spring is still loaded as the arm drops; keep clear underneath.

universal.zh: 後輪的「轉向節」，不會轉向，但五根連桿都接在它身上，一起決定後輪的外傾與前束。
universal.en: The rear equivalent of a knuckle; it does not steer, but all five links attach to it and together set the wheel's camber and toe.

specific.zh: F30 後羽臂是鋁合金（待查證），輪轂軸承壓在裡面。
specific.en: The F30 rear carrier is aluminium (unverified), with the hub bearing pressed in.

universal.zh: 五連桿裡最上面的 A 形臂，控制外傾角。
universal.en: The topmost A-arm of the five-link, controlling camber.

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在承重高度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Torque bush bolts at ride height.

commonIssues.zh: 襯套撕裂：後輪過坎異音、吃胎。
commonIssues.en: Torn bushes: rear knocks over bumps and tyre wear.

universal.zh: 最下面、承重的那根：彈簧坐在它上面。
universal.en: The lowest, load-bearing link; the spring sits on it.

specific.zh: 偏心螺絲可以調外傾（待查證）。
specific.en: An eccentric bolt adjusts camber (unverified).

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在承重高度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Torque bush bolts at ride height.

commonIssues.zh: 襯套撕裂：後輪過坎異音、吃胎。
commonIssues.en: Torn bushes: rear knocks over bumps and tyre wear.

universal.zh: 往前伸到車身的那根，承受加速與煞車的前後力。
universal.en: The link reaching forward to the body; it takes fore-and-aft loads from acceleration and braking.

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在承重高度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Torque bush bolts at ride height.

commonIssues.zh: 襯套撕裂：後輪過坎異音、吃胎。
commonIssues.en: Torn bushes: rear knocks over bumps and tyre wear.

universal.zh: 最後面那根短桿，長度決定後輪的前束。
universal.en: The short rearmost link; its length sets rear toe.

specific.zh: 偏心螺絲調前束（待查證）。
specific.en: An eccentric bolt sets toe (unverified).

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在承重高度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Torque bush bolts at ride height.

commonIssues.zh: 襯套撕裂：後輪過坎異音、吃胎。
commonIssues.en: Torn bushes: rear knocks over bumps and tyre wear.

universal.zh: 第五根：和上三角臂一起定住輪子上端。
universal.en: The fifth link; with the upper wishbone it locates the top of the wheel.

warnings.zh: 襯套螺絲要在承重高度鎖緊。
warnings.en: Torque bush bolts at ride height.

universal.zh: 後面的鋼架：差速器掛在上面，五連桿內側全部接在它身上，透過四個大橡膠襯套鎖到車身。
universal.en: The rear steel frame: the differential hangs from it and the inner ends of all five links attach to it; four big rubber bushes bolt it to the body.

specific.zh: 模擬器裡把五連桿當作副車架的子件：拆副車架時，連桿跟著整包下來（實車也常這樣整組放下）。
specific.en: The simulator treats the five links as children of the subframe: when it comes down, the links come with it, as on the real car when the whole assembly is dropped.

warnings.en: Subframe bush bolts are single-use (unverified).
